items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I also saw Fats Waller at the Paradise Theatre.

ctx.x: listened to Fats Waller and all of them...

I also saw Fats Waller at the Paradise Theatre. Heh-heh, I can tell you something real funny about that. He came to Detroit with just his basic group, just the five pieces that he'd use all the time. Sedric... I don't remember the tenor player's name, but his last name was Sedric. [GENE SEDRIC] Anyway, that week he puts this local band together to play the engagement, and they drink 52 fifths of whiskey that week, the band! Yeah, he was responsible for the whiskey for the band, and he had a bunch of whiskey…
